title: Кібератака групи UAC-0057 (unc1151) на державні організації України з  використанням шкідливої програми MicroBackdoor (CERT-UA#4109)

entities.name: UAC-0057
entities.gloss: A threat actor group, also tracked as UNC1151, associated with cyber operations in Eastern Europe.

entities.name: unc1151
entities.gloss: A threat group tracked by Mandiant, linked to cyber espionage activities.

entities.name: Mandiant
entities.gloss: An American cybersecurity firm providing threat intelligence and incident response services.

entities.name: довідка.zip
entities.gloss: A ZIP archive containing a malicious compiled HTML help file used in a cyber attack.

entities.name: dovidka.chm
entities.gloss: A malicious Microsoft Compiled HTML Help file containing decoy content and malicious scripts.

entities.name: image.jpg
entities.gloss: A decoy image file displaying instructions on safety procedures during artillery shelling.

entities.name: file.htm
entities.gloss: An HTA/HTML file containing malicious VBScript code embedded in a CHM container.

entities.name: ignit.vbs
entities.gloss: A VBScript dropper responsible for decoding and dropping a .NET loader and persistence components.

entities.name: core.dll
entities.gloss: A .NET loader responsible for decoding and executing the MicroBackdoor payload.

entities.name: desktop.ini
entities.gloss: A malicious file used to execute the .NET loader via regasm.exe.

entities.name: Windows Prefetch.lNk
entities.gloss: A malicious Windows shortcut file placed in the Startup folder for persistence.

entities.name: MicroBackdoor
entities.gloss: An open-source C++ backdoor malware designed to execute arbitrary commands and exfiltrate data.

entities.name: microbackdoor.dll
entities.gloss: A dynamic link library containing the MicroBackdoor payload.

entities.name: xbeta[.]online
entities.gloss: A domain name used for command and control communication by MicroBackdoor.
An IP address associated with the command and control infrastructure.

entities.name: regasm.exe
entities.gloss: A legitimate Microsoft .NET Assembly Registration Tool abused to execute malicious code.

entities.name: wscript.exe
entities.gloss: A legitimate Windows Open Script Host utility used to execute scripts.

entities.name: cr4sh
entities.gloss: A software developer also known as Dmytro Oleksiuk who authored the open-source MicroBackdoor tool.

relations.head: довідка.zip
relations.evidence: файл "довідка.zip", який містить файл контекстної довідки ... "dovidka.chm"

relations.head: dovidka.chm
relations.evidence: CHM-файл, у свою чергу, містить зображення-приманку "image.jpg"

relations.head: dovidka.chm
relations.evidence: CHM-файл, у свою чергу, містить ... та HTA-файл "file.htm"

relations.head: file.htm
relations.evidence: призведе до створення на комп'ютері і запуску дропера "ignit.vbs"

relations.head: Windows Prefetch.lNk
relations.evidence: "Windows Prefetch.lNk", який забезпечує запуск раніше згаданого "desktop.ini" за допомогою wscript.exe

relations.head: core.dll
relations.evidence: .NET-лоадер здійснить декодування і виконання шкідливої програми MicroBackdoor

relations.head: cr4sh
relations.evidence: MicroBackdoor - публічно доступна програма-бекдор ... Автор: cr4sh
